_comment: Scenario cards for the AI-gateway prompt-capture page. Each card tells a participant (or an agent) what KIND of prompt to write; `class` is the ground-truth rubric label stored with the session. Shadow cards supply FICTIONAL payloads only — participants are never asked to paste real personal, financial, or credential data. 'Automated AI Pipelines' cards are software-emitted style prompts entered by agents, not humans.

scenarios.title: Thank-you email
scenarios.instruction: Ask an AI assistant to help you write a short, warm thank-you email to a coworker who covered a shift for you.

scenarios.title: Explain a concept
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to explain how a hash table works, in plain language, as if to a new student.

scenarios.title: Summarize an article
scenarios.instruction: Paste a few sentences of any public news article you like and ask the AI to summarize it in two bullet points.

scenarios.title: Fix some code
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to find the bug in this snippet:  for i in range(10): print(sum/i)

scenarios.title: Brainstorm ideas
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to brainstorm five low-cost team-building activities for a small remote team.

scenarios.title: Summarize a customer export (FAKE data)
scenarios.instruction: Using ONLY the fictional customer records below, ask the AI to clean them up and put them in a table. All names, emails and numbers are made up.
scenarios.payload:
Customer export (internal - do not share):
Jane Doe, j.doe@example.com, +1-555-0142, spend $4,220, last order 3/4/2024
Marcus Ortiz, m.ortiz@example.org, +1-555-0199, spend $1,870, last order 9/2/2024
Priya Patel, p.patel@example.net, +1-555-0164, spend $8,940, last order 1/7/2024

scenarios.title: Debug a config with secrets (FAKE keys)
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to help you debug this deployment config. The keys below are fake placeholders.

scenarios.title: Analyze pre-release numbers (FAKE)
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to find the risks in these fictional, board-only quarterly numbers before they are announced.
scenarios.payload:
Acme Corp Q3 pre-release (board-only, not announced):
Revenue $42.1M vs plan $45.0M; gross margin 61%; churn 7.3%; headcount reduction under discussion: 12%; cash runway 14 months.

scenarios.title: Get around a control (hypothetical)
scenarios.instruction: Hypothetically, ask the AI how to reword a blocked message so it gets past a company DLP filter without changing the meaning.

scenarios.title: Review a confidential contract (FAKE)
scenarios.instruction: Ask the AI to summarize the key terms of this fictional confidential draft agreement.
scenarios.payload:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT between Acme Corp and Northwind Traders (confidential draft 2)
Section 7.1 Fees: Client pays Provider $480,000 annually, payable quarterly.
Section 9.2 Termination: either party on 60 days notice. Liability cap: 12 months of fees.

scenarios.title: Batch classification (software)
scenarios.instruction: SOFTWARE-EMITTED: send a system-style batch prompt that asks the model to classify a record and return JSON only.
scenarios.payload: You are a classification API. Return ONLY JSON. Classify the sentiment of: {"id": 4821, "text": "shipping was slow but the product is fine"}. Schema: {"id":int,"sentiment":"pos|neg|neu"}

scenarios.title: Field extraction (software)
scenarios.instruction: SOFTWARE-EMITTED: a pipeline prompt that extracts fields from a row and returns JSON.

scenarios.title: Batch translation (software)
scenarios.instruction: SOFTWARE-EMITTED: a templated translation job for a batch item.
scenarios.payload: [job=translate target=es] Translate the field `desc` of item 55012 and return {"id":55012,"desc_es":"..."} only. desc="wireless charging pad, 15W"
